name: lstat64
synopsis: int lstat(const char *restrict pathname, struct stat *restrict statbuf);
description: lstat() retrieves file status information for the specified pathname. If pathname is a symbolic link, it returns information about the link itself, not the target file. No permissions are required on the file, but execute permission is needed on directories in the path.

parameters.name: pathname
parameters.description: Pathname of the file to retrieve status for

parameters.name: statbuf
parameters.description: Pointer to a stat structure to store the file status information

return_value.failure: Returns -1 on error, and errno is set

errors.description: Search permission is denied for one of the directories in the path prefix of pathname
Too many symbolic links encountered while traversing the path
A component of pathname does not exist or is a dangling symbolic link
A component of the path prefix of pathname is not a directory
File size, inode number, or number of blocks cannot be represented
